name: Fear and Loneliness in Latona's Void
source:
Many years ago, you entered Latona's Void, as an escape from your life. Until one day, you decided to no longer wait in the darkness of this void, ready to leave and move on.

[From [url=https://harlequindiver.itch.io/fear-and-loneliness]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
许多年前，为了逃离自己的生活，你走进了拉托娜的虚空。直到某一天，你决定不再在这片黑暗中等待。你准备离开，继续往前走。

［摘自[url=https://harlequindiver.itch.io/fear-and-loneliness]itch.io[/url]］
